function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Pet‑friendly train stations near Miami** | Station | City | Train Service | Pet Policy (as of 2024) | Notes | |---------|------|---------------|------------------------|-------| | **West Palm Beach Amtrak Station** | West Palm Beach (≈ 30 mi north of Miami) | Amtrak – Silver Star & Silver Meteor | • Pets allowed in the passenger car only if they are in a carrier that fits under the seat.
• Must be leashed or muzzled if not in a carrier.
• No pets in the baggage car.
• No dogs over 50 lb. | The station has a small waiting area with a few benches; no dedicated pet‑friendly zone, but the platform is open and well ventilated. | | **Fort Lauderdale Amtrak Station** | Fort Lauderdale (≈ 25 mi north of Miami) | Amtrak – Silver Star & Silver Meteor | • Same carrier rules as above.
• Dogs over 50 lb. are not permitted.
• Leashed dogs allowed in the passenger car. | The station has a covered waiting area and a small café; no special pet facilities. | | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** | Miami (airport‑connected hub) | Amtrak – Silver Star & Silver Meteor (via the nearby West Palm Beach station) | • Amtrak’s pet rules apply; the MIA itself does not have a dedicated pet area. | The center is fully accessible and has plenty of seating, but pets must be in carriers or leashed. | ### How to travel with pets from Miami 1. **Book early** – Amtrak requires a pet reservation. Call 1‑800‑733‑7300 or use the Amtrak website to add a pet to your ticket. 2. **Carrier requirements** – The carrier must fit under the seat and be secure. Small dogs and cats are usually fine; larger dogs need a carrier that fits the size limit. 3. **Leash/muzzle** – If the pet is not in a carrier, it must be leashed or muzzled at all times. 4. **Baggage car** – Pets are not allowed in the baggage car. 5. **Weight limit** – Dogs over 50 lb. are generally not permitted on Amtrak trains. ### Tips for a smooth trip - **Arrive early** to allow time for checking in and getting your pet settled. - **Bring water and snacks** for your pet; the train has a café but pet‑friendly food is limited. - **Check the latest policy** on the Amtrak website or by calling customer service, as rules can change. If you’re looking for a more local option, consider using a pet‑friendly bus service or rideshare to the nearest Amtrak station. Safe travels!
